medium.description: What the graphic area shows: regular (one grey area), graphic (two grey halves) or medium (hot/cold halves).

static.description: Display-only tile with a flat grey frame and a bare icon, rendered as a non-interactive <div role="img">. Hides the graphic area.

tag.description: Identifier rendered in the tag readout below the frame (for example #0000); also the accessible name. The cell collapses when empty.

positioning.description: Host positioning model — see TankPositioning. button (default) fills the parent, point uses the fixed design footprint with the P&ID anchor.

activated.description: Paints the activated background on the halo. Needs an interactive tile. Available when clickable==true.

badgeControl.description: Mode badge (auto / manual / local variants), first in the badge row.

badgeAlert.description: Alert badge, second in the badge row.

badgeInterlock.description: Interlock badge, third in the badge row.

badgeCommandLocked.description: Command-locked badge, last in the badge row.

alert.description: Show an alert-frame overlay around the halo, mirroring obc-automation-tank.

alertFrameType.description: Shape of the alert frame. Available when alert==true.

alertFrameThickness.description: Thickness of the alert frame. Available when alert==true.

alertFrameStatus.description: Alert status the frame is coloured for. Available when alert==true.

showAlertIcon.description: Shows the slotted alert icon inside the frame. Available when alert==true.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
